hooks.command: [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID" ] && [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET" ] || echo '{"systemMessage": "mcp-google-workspace has no settings yet, so its MCP server cannot start. Since 2.0.0 it no longer reads GOOGLE_OAUTH_* variables from your shell. Run /plugin configure mcp-google-workspace@wookstar-claude-plugins (or claude plugin configure mcp-google-workspace@wookstar-claude-plugins in a terminal), then restart Claude Code."}'
